final_message: Fixed: `NestedUnary()` in `parser/expr.go` was returning `3` instead of the correct `5`, causing incorrect evaluation of nested unary expressions (e.g., double negation) while the binary form test (`TestBinaryForm`) was already passing/unaffected. Updated the return value to `5`, ran the full test suite (both `TestNestedUnary` and `TestBinaryForm` pass), and committed the change.
